fieldNotes.imageryLimitation: This is a newly-opened facility - the $675M Nestlé greenfield beverage factory + distribution center, which celebrated its opening on 28 January 2025. The only satellite imagery currently available (Maxar) shows the site MID-CONSTRUCTION: the building roof is still being installed (steel framing and blue under-construction roof sections visible) and the surrounding yard is raw graded dirt with construction laydown. Street View panos are from 2019-2021, pre-construction (empty desert). The building footprint and broad parcel are confirmed, but the operational truck-yard configuration (gate, guard booth, dock count, drop-yard layout, lane counts, staging) CANNOT be reliably read from construction-phase imagery. Most classification fields are best-effort inferences from the facility type, scale and modern-build status, and are flagged uncertain. Confidence: low. Recommend re-audit when post-2025 operational imagery is available.
fieldNotes.locating: Roster coords (33.558619, -112.384378, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, moved 47m) were accurate to within ~150m. Locked center 33.55520, -112.38120.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred true - a brand-new (2024-25) modern food-grade Nestlé beverage factory + distribution center will have a controlled, guarded truck gate. Not visible in construction imagery; flagged uncertain.

fieldNotes.dockDoors: Inferred 25-50 band for a 630,000 sq ft combined factory + DC; dock-door positioning is partly visible on the south building face but not countable in construction imagery.
